code.why: This is the host process around fetch. The life runs through the in-memory World; conformance separately calls server.ts and walks the life over HTTP.

The credential door in a World that declares no managed Postgres: the walk binds every World of a pack declaring managedDatabase to one (twin-world packages/twin-standard/src/walk/vendor-fetch.ts), as a World serving an application of this pack declares its postgres service, so the project always has a database to hand out there.
